text:
Mira K: Quick review please 1 SolarisHW uploaded their badge + hero to Figma: https://figma.com/file/solaris-hero. Need check on: micro-tile (140x140), hero lockup on dark image, alt text, and quote attribution. Would like to publish Tues AM.
Devon (design): Downloaded. Compact mark works for 140px; horizontal lockup clips at 480px, add 8px left padding. CTA on dark fails AA; recommend #003e99. Export list: compact SVG, PNG 140/280, hero 1200x420.
Sam (Legal): We need signed asset consent for the customer quote and confirmation of the exact title. Draft consent received but missing signer name. Solaris Ops, can you re-upload signed PDF with full name and date?
Solaris Ops: Uploaded updated consent (doc id SH-2026-AG-signed) and confirmed byline: "Ana Ruiz, Director of ML Engineering". Also attached high-res SVGs including reversed white.
Devon (design): Great 1 will re-export PNGs without halo and push updated CTA color. For micro-tile use compact mark centered with 8px clearspace.
Jordan (Marketplace): Reminder: title <=60 chars, short desc <=140 chars, alt <=125 chars. Paste proposed strings and we'll validate. Also we run automated contrast check during staging.
Mira K: Proposed strings:
short_title: SolarisHW 1 Redwood integration for efficient inference
short_desc: Joint solution reducing inference cost and improving tail latency for production LLMs
alt_text: SolarisHW compact mark 1 inference hardware partner for low-latency inference
Devon (design): I'll include the alt_text in the metadata and upload exports to the shared folder now: https://files.redwood.com/solaris/exports_v1.
Sam (Legal): Consent checked, signer and date present. No legal blockers for quote or logo use.
Jordan (Marketplace): I'll validate lengths and schedule publish for Tue 09:00 PT once assets are live and AA checks pass. Ping here when uploads complete. :white_check_mark:
